name: Pinterest Ads
label: Pinterest API v5 — ad accounts, campaigns, analytics, conversions
description: Official Pinterest API v5 (only supported version; v3 retired) at https://api.pinterest.com/v5. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Ads under the same /v5 host with ads scopes. Organic Pins belong in Social — not this node. Auth: Bearer access_token (or conversion token for conversion.upload). Customer owns the Pinterest ad account. Hash customer-list identifiers; never log Bearer, emails, or MAIDs. Ads write/analytics need Standard access (operator completes review).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: adAccount.list | campaign.create | campaign.list | adGroup.create | adGroup.list | ad.create | ad.list | analytics.get | audience.create | conversion.upload.

schema.label: ad_account_id
schema.description: Overrides config. Path /ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/…

schema.label: campaigns
schema.description: campaign.create official array of CampaignCreateRequest. Each item: name (required), objective_type (AWARENESS|CONSIDERATION|WEB_CONVERSION|CATALOG_SALES|WEB_SESSIONS|VIDEO_COMPLETION), status (ACTIVE|PAUSED), daily_spend_cap / lifetime_spend_cap in microcurrency, start_time, end_time, tracking_urls. Example: [{"name":"Q4","objective_type":"WEB_CONVERSION","status":"ACTIVE"}].

schema.label: ad_groups
schema.description: adGroup.create official array. Each item: name, campaign_id, billable_event (CLICKTHROUGH|IMPRESSION|VIDEO_V_50_MRC), bid_in_micro_currency, budget_in_micro_currency, budget_type (DAILY|CBO_ADGROUP), targeting_spec, start_time, end_time, status. Example: [{"name":"US","campaign_id":"123","billable_event":"CLICKTHROUGH"}].

schema.label: ads
schema.description: ad.create official array of AdsCreateRequest. Each item: ad_group_id, creative_type, pin_id, name, status (ACTIVE|PAUSED|ARCHIVED), destination_url, tracking_urls, collection_items_destination_url_template, customizable_cta_type. Example: [{"ad_group_id":"456","pin_id":"789","creative_type":"REGULAR"}].

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: List page size; cap 100.

schema.label: bookmark
schema.description: Pagination bookmark. One page per node run.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: analytics.get YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: analytics.get YYYY-MM-DD. ≤ 90 days after start.

schema.label: columns
schema.description: analytics.get required metric list. Common: SPEND_IN_DOLLAR, IMPRESSION_1, CLICKTHROUGH_1, ENGAGEMENT_1, TOTAL_CONVERSIONS. Sent as the columns query value. Example: ["SPEND_IN_DOLLAR","IMPRESSION_1"].

schema.label: granularity
schema.description: analytics.get required. EXACT: TOTAL | DAY | HOUR | WEEK | MONTH. Example: DAY.

schema.label: name
schema.description: audience.create list name.

schema.label: list_type
schema.description: audience.create customer-list type. EXACT: EMAIL | MAID | LR_ID | PINTEREST_USER_ID. Records must already be SHA-256 hashed. Example: EMAIL.

schema.label: records
schema.description: Hashed identifiers only. Never raw emails. Large lists: split; async jobs out of v1.

schema.label: data
schema.description: conversion.upload one event object escape hatch merged into data[0]. Named event_name/action_source/event_time/… win.

schema.label: test
schema.description: conversion.upload query. true = validate without recording. Send true. Example: true.

schema.label: entity_statuses
schema.description: List filter. Comma-separated ACTIVE,PAUSED,ARCHIVED. campaign.list / adGroup.list / ad.list. Example: ACTIVE,PAUSED.

schema.label: campaign_ids
schema.description: Comma-separated campaign ids filter for campaign.list / adGroup.list / ad.list. Example: 111,222.

schema.label: ad_group_ids
schema.description: Comma-separated ad group ids filter for adGroup.list / ad.list. Example: 333.

schema.label: ad_ids
schema.description: Comma-separated ad ids filter for ad.list. Example: 444.

schema.label: click_window_days
schema.description: analytics.get attribution click window. EXACT: 0 | 1 | 7 | 14 | 30 | 60. Example: 30.

schema.label: engagement_window_days
schema.description: analytics.get engagement window. EXACT: 0 | 1 | 7 | 14 | 30 | 60. Example: 30.

schema.label: view_window_days
schema.description: analytics.get view window. EXACT: 0 | 1 | 7 | 14 | 30 | 60. Example: 1.

schema.label: conversion_report_time
schema.description: analytics.get. EXACT: TIME_OF_AD_ACTION | TIME_OF_CONVERSION. Example: TIME_OF_AD_ACTION.

schema.label: event_name
schema.description: conversion.upload event_name. Wired to data[0].event_name. checkout | add_to_cart | page_visit | signup | watch_video | lead | search | view_category | custom.

schema.label: action_source
schema.description: conversion.upload action_source. Wired to data[0].action_source. EXACT: web | app_android | app_ios | offline.

schema.label: event_time
schema.description: conversion.upload unix seconds. Wired to data[0].event_time.

schema.label: event_id
schema.description: conversion.upload dedup id. Wired to data[0].event_id.

schema.label: user_data
schema.description: conversion.upload user_data. Wired to data[0].user_data. SHA-256 em / hashed_maids or IP+UA. Never log.

schema.label: custom_data
schema.description: conversion.upload custom_data {value, currency, order_id, content_ids, …}. Wired to data[0].custom_data.

schema.label: event_source_url
schema.description: conversion.upload page URL. Wired to data[0].event_source_url.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: adAccount.list | campaign.create | campaign.list | adGroup.create | adGroup.list | ad.create | ad.list | analytics.get | audience.create | conversion.upload.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (or conversion access token). Never on INPUT. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Ad account id
configurationParameters.description: Advertiser / ad account id. Path param when INPUT omits it. Required for all ops except adAccount.list.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
